title: The Perihelion Parade Accord
logline: A station cultural board moves the annual jubilee procession route away from traditional dockside bazaars to an exclusive corporate promenade, threatening independent merchants with ruin.

roles.description: Master of ceremonies for the annual perihelion jubilee; theatrical, evasive, quietly bound to retail performance guarantees.
Represents independent food vendors and craft stalls on the outer ring; loud, exhausted, facing bankruptcy if the parade bypasses his market.
A private security escort clearing commercial shuttle traffic from the newly chartered inner viewing lane.
The union of small dockside stalls and food cart operators who depend on the annual jubilee crowds.
The corporate commercial consortium owning the new sunward viewing galleries and luxury boutiques.
The grand ceremonial dock where festival floats and ceremonial barges assemble.
The uninsulated outer docking circle where jubilee celebrations have been hosted for three generations.

public_situation: Festival flags deck the station as the cultural ministry announces that the perihelion parade will bypass {role:outer_bazaar} for safety reasons.
private_truth: {role:festival_director} signed an exclusive contract guaranteeing foot traffic to {role:promenade_retail_trust} in exchange for luxury gallery construction bonds.

beats.public_change: Security buoys deploy along the outer bazaar approach, routing ceremonial traffic inward toward the corporate promenade.

missions.reason: He hires an outside pilot to buy festive pyrotechnic display canisters from an industrial station and deliver them to illuminate the traditional docks.
missions.private_fact: His vendors pooled their emergency scrip reserves to pay for the fireworks, hoping to lure festivalgoers back to the outer ring.

beats.public_change: Bazaar merchants block parade marshals from testing ceremonial lights while the director threatens to ban outer vendors from the concourse.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to scan the parade committee's staging beacons to extract the route charter contract proving the route switch was sold.
missions.private_fact: His sister runs one of the high-end apparel boutiques in the new promenade and warned him about the secret foot-traffic clauses.

beats.public_change: {role:promenade_cutter} begins impounding bazaar sound barges entering the central ceremonial canal.

missions.reason: He needs the cutter's pulse cannons disabled so the outer merchants' music float can reach the main marshaling basin.
missions.private_fact: The cutter captain hails offering twenty-five thousand credits and a permanent prime boutique berth on the promenade if the pilot drops the contract.

beats.public_change: Dignitaries gather at {role:jubilee_concourse} as the herald prepares to ignite the jubilee torch and launch the parade run.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to courier the documented retail guarantee contract directly to the presiding magistrate before the launch signal fires.
missions.private_fact: He fears that if the traditional route is lost this year, the outer bazaar will be permanently condemned for cargo staging.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot arrives at the ceremonial dais holding the contract exposing the festival director's private commercial deal.

options.label: Table the contract to void the route diversion and return the jubilee to the outer bazaar
Sell the contract to the promenade retail trust in exchange for exclusive trading rights
Broker a dual-route compromise having the parade pass through both the bazaar and the promenade

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot tables the contract, exposing the commercial collusion.
resolutions.summary: The route contract is voided. {role:festival_director} is ousted from the committee, and the jubilee parade returns to {role:outer_bazaar} amid wild public cheering.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved the station's annual festival route had been sold out to corporate luxury malls.

resolutions.reached_by: The contract is suppressed or the deadline passes, letting the corporate route stand.
resolutions.summary: The parade circles the corporate promenade exclusively. {role:promenade_retail_trust} reaps record profits while {role:outer_bazaar} stalls collapse into ruin.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a dual-route accord sharing parade stages between both markets.
resolutions.summary: A compromise creates a split procession. Both {role:outer_bazaar} and {role:promenade_retail_trust} share the festival crowds, sustaining small vendors and new shops alike.

loose_threads.detail: The municipal parade authorization cites corridor security clearances issued four months before the route alteration was drafted.
Promenade boutique concession leases jumped four hundred percent two weeks before the public announcement of the route switch.

radio_hooks: Festival heralds announce record fireworks shipments for the upcoming perihelion jubilee.
Outer ring shopkeepers threaten general dock shutdown over disputed parade route coordinates.
Luxury promenade developers promise unprecedented retail spectacles during festival week.

voice_direction.festival_director: Flamboyant, grandiose, and slippery. Treats serious commercial disputes as petty artistic misunderstandings and speaks in breathless hyperbole.
voice_direction.bazaar_alderman: Blunt, weary, and sarcastic. Counts coins between phrases and punctures high-flown ceremonial rhetoric with sharp working-class realism.
